【原视频简介】
I challenged myself to build a computer by searching for the fastest gaming PC components on Amazon. Every single part, from the processor to the GPU, was determined by the first organic search result that appeared. There is no swapping parts and no cheating, meaning I have to use whatever Amazon suggests, regardless of the cost or compatibility.

This experiment shows exactly what happens when you let an algorithm decide your hardware specs. You will see if this method results in a functional working machine or a total disaster... 

Will this be the best custom build that we have had on this channel?
